entries.title: Ops Updates & Error Log
entries.summary: New Ops sub-panels for platform changelog and a session-scoped error log. Changelog loads from repo data with timeout fallback; errors capture API, engine, broker, and dossier failures in plain English.

entries.title: Honest operator gates
entries.summary: Probe OK is separated from runtime evidence across Dashboard, Playbook, and Ops. Boards may show cached or precomputed output when the engine has not run this session — capital decisions require fresh runtime proof.

entries.title: Random Walk guardrails
entries.summary: Passive baseline and complexity challenge strips on Today explain when active management is unlikely to beat buy-and-hold after costs. Deploy gates respect net-edge after turnover and spread burden.

entries.title: IBKR health matrix
entries.summary: Broker status distinguishes gateway reachable, session active, market-data farms, and handoff readiness — not a single green/red connected flag. Partial degraded states are labeled honestly.

entries.title: Decision hierarchy & surface authority
entries.summary: Five-level binding hierarchy (page gate → execution) blocks full deploy when tradeability is WAIT or execution readiness is incomplete. Research surfaces cannot override capital gates.

entries.title: Discord notifications demoted
entries.summary: Discord is optional operator colour — unconfigured webhooks no longer surface as errors. Notification events remain in Ops as informational context only.

entries.title: Stock intel fast path
entries.summary: Dossier supports lite core load plus async enrichments to reduce cold-start timeouts. Failures are logged with suggested retry actions in the Error Log.
